title: Seven in the family band after Battles joined
summary: Four sons and two cousins made six musicians, and Edgar Battle, who lived with the family young, made seven.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, listen, -- well, let's talk a minute more about your father. Like you're saying -- so, the whole family turned out to be musical and it all comes from that side of the family. Now, you did talk a little bit about this with Stan, but -- so there were four sons that were all musical and two cousins that were brought up in the family, too.
And when Battles came in, that was seven
of us. That's a pretty good-sized band. Well, did Battles -- what was he? A neighbor or what?
Yeah, when he lived with us, he was very young.
Oh, he did live with you? I didn't realize that. I know Stanley must have already said that. So that made seven of you.
